definition: fraction of n_shots where Z_L = X0 X1 X2 destructive readout yields +1 (= parity(dat[0],dat[1],dat[2]) = 0 after H rotation on q0,q1,q2)
logical_operator_used: Z_L = X0 X1 X2 (Shor [[9,1,3]] code logical Z representative)
measurement_protocol: and after measuring all 8 stabilizer ancillae,
apply Hadamard to data qubits 0, 1, 2 (rotates X-eigenstates to Z-eigenstates),
measure all 9 data qubits in Z basis,
compute Z_L bit = dat[0] XOR dat[1] XOR dat[2] (parity over block-1 X-rotated qubits)

expected_distribution_noiseless.rationale: |0_L> is exact +1 eigenstate of X_L_dual = X0X1X2; Born rule -> deterministic outcome

raw10_caveat: logical_zero_ratio = 1.0 is the noiseless-Aer DETERMINISTIC outcome; real hardware would show 1 - logical_zero_ratio in [0.02, 0.15] typical due to CNOT + readout noise. Toy demonstration only.
